1 Why I decided to write this post

This post (as most others in this blog will be) is an example that I have to recall quite often, but can never remember the details. On one hand, it is a very simple example, on the other hand, it shows a huge difference between the algebraic and complex geometry. For instance, it shows that some naïve analogies between algebraic and holomorphic “toric” geometries can not literally be true. In particular, it shows how the relationship between Cartier divisors and line bundles breaks down in the non-algebraic case.
